note: Painted pieces for the paper-world film. Image 1 (work/style_ref.png, the table-city target still) is attached to every call as the style reference. Every piece is one isolated object on a transparent background, lit warm from the upper left; code mirrors a piece for the other side of the candle.
style: Image 1 is a style reference only: match its medium and photographic finish exactly (a macro photograph of handmade paper-craft: cut and folded matte card with visible paper fibre, pale cut edges, small folded card tab stands, warm candle light from the upper left, gentle shading). Do not copy its composition. Paint ONLY the single object described: whole, uncropped, centred, seen from the front at eye level, filling most of the image, on a fully transparent background. No table, no tablecloth, no ground, no cast shadow on any surface, no background at all. No text, no letters, no logos.

treeman.prompt: A single flat paper cut-out standee of an old man in side profile, facing right, slightly stooped, wearing a brimmed hat and a long coat, carrying a large backpack on his back and holding a walking stick in front of him. Cut from moss-green card, the backpack a second layer of tan card glued on. A plain silhouette with no facial features at all. He stands on a small folded card tab at his feet.

guard.prompt: A single flat paper cut-out standee of a prison guard in side profile, facing right, standing upright with chest out and hands clasped behind his back. Cut from navy blue card. He wears a peaked police-style officer's cap with a wide flat crown that overhangs front and back and a short stiff visor, a tiny gold foil badge on the front of the cap, a uniform jacket with a belt, a ring of keys hanging at the hip, straight trousers and boots. A plain silhouette with no facial features at all. He stands on a small folded card tab at his feet.

citizen.prompt: A single flat paper cut-out standee of an ordinary man in a city coat in side profile, facing right, mid-stride, arms at his sides, no hat. Cut from one piece of dusty brick-red card. A plain silhouette with no facial features at all. He stands on a small folded card tab at his feet.

tower_plate.prompt: A single paper-craft pop-up tower made of four stacked round tiers that get narrower toward the top, like a tiered drum, in peach and umber card, each tier ringed with rows of small arched window cut-outs glowing warm from inside, with a small round cap on top. It sits on a flat round white paper plate, seen slightly from above so the plate is a shallow ellipse at its base.

tower_glass.prompt: A single tall paper-craft tower in the shape of a wine glass: a faceted goblet bowl folded from green card with rows of small window cut-outs glowing warm yellow from inside, on a thin green card stem and a round card foot.

fence_trio.prompt: Three separate flat card cut-outs standing upright side by side with clear gaps between them: a table knife, a fork and a spoon, each cut from pale silver-grey card, handles at the bottom, each as tall as the image allows, each held upright by its own small folded card tab at the base.
